_readme: Reference only. Do not put a real token in this file and do not commit one. The install guides (docs/install-windows.md, docs/install-mac.md) add this server with one command that keeps the token on your own computer. Server: @roychri/mcp-server-asana (npm). Token = the Asana personal access token for YOUR helper account 'Claude, (on behalf of <Name>)', from 1Password item 'Asana PAT -- Claude on behalf of <Name>'.
